newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish prisoners riot, take hostage.
newsitem.headline: Turkish prisoners riot, take hostage.

text.p: Inmates at a Turkish jail rioted, took a warden hostage and set fire to their cells in protest at poor conditions, Anatolian news agency said on Wednesday.

It said there were no reports of injuries in the incident at Istanbul's Metris prison, which began on Tuesday night. The rioters were jailed for criminal offenses and had no political demands, the agency said.
"I listened to their requests. They said they wanted better treatment and conditions," Anatolian quoted Istanbul governor Ridvan Yenisen as saying after visiting the prison.
Police and ambulances were standing by outside the jail, which holds 1,200 people despite being built for only 700 inmates.
